Steffen B. Laursen (cited in the literature as Laursen SB) is a gastroenterologist and professor at Aarhus University Hospital [^src1]. This article specifically concerns Steffen B. Laursen and should not be confused with other researchers or individuals who share the same initials [^src1].

Laursen is a central researcher in the fields of peptic ulcer bleeding and endoscopy [^src1]. His contributions are documented in the 2024 Annual Report for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen), a publication that highlights the database's role as a vital tool for clinical quality development and scientific research in acute surgery [^src1]. Within this report, Laursen's name appears as an author in four separate scientific references listed on page 96 [^src1]. 

Among his collaborative work, Laursen has co-authored research with [[schaffalitzky-de-muckadell-ob|Schaffalitzky de Muckadell OB]] [^src1]. One of their notable joint publications investigates the clinical impact of Selective Serotonin Receptor Inhibitors (SSRIs), establishing that the use of these medications is not associated with an increased risk of endoscopy-refractory bleeding, rebleeding, or mortality in patients suffering from peptic ulcer bleeding [^src1].
